description: Add an action to buttons or form fields for an event: go to a destination, page, view, URL or state, show/hide fields, play video, sound or animation, open a file, zoom, clear, print or submit the form (Buttons and Forms panel > Actions)

autoReverseOnRollOff.description: animation: reverse the animation on roll off

destination.description: go_to_destination: a text anchor, page destination or bookmark by name, or a page (a page destination is made if none exists); with document, in another open InDesign document (a cross-document jump)

document.description: Path of another InDesign document, open in InDesign, holding the destination

name.description: Destination or bookmark name (with pageIndex: the name of the page destination)

event.description: Event: On Release or Tap (MOUSE_UP), On Click (MOUSE_DOWN), On Roll Over (MOUSE_ENTER), On Roll Off (MOUSE_EXIT), On Focus, On Blur

goBackOnRollOff.description: go_to_state: go back to the previous state on roll off

hide.description: show_hide_fields: ids of buttons and fields to hide

loop.description: go_to_next_state, go_to_previous_state: stop on last/first state when false

mediaItem.description: video, sound: the movie or sound (or its frame) id; animation: the animated item id

mediaOperation.description: video, sound, animation: what to do (default PLAY); PLAY_FROM_NAVIGATION_POINT is video only, REVERSE_PLAYBACK animation only

multiStateObject.description: go_to_state, go_to_next_state, go_to_previous_state: the multi-state object id

navigationPoint.description: video with PLAY_FROM_NAVIGATION_POINT: the navigation point name

show.description: show_hide_fields: ids of buttons and fields to show

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

url.description: go_to_url: the URL; submit_form: where to submit (a URL or mailto:)

zoom.description: Zoom for go_to_* page, view and destination actions

name: add_button_action
title: Add Button Action
